smart_contract.description: On-chain contract code and the state it governs. The most common in-scope class, and normally the highest-paying: a finding here reaches funds directly.

blockchain_dlt.description: Node software, consensus, cryptography, bridges and other protocol-layer infrastructure, as distinct from application contracts deployed on top of it. Graded separately because the blast radius of a finding is the network rather than one deployment.

websites_and_applications.description: Front ends, hosted APIs, and off-chain application infrastructure. Graded separately because the same severity label normally pays less here than on-chain: the failure reaches users rather than principal.
